title: Piercing Frame Solo #096 (일반 가슴 컷 · P200 정의형 · 픽시컷 · 스트로베리블론드 · 메이크업 AoDaiGlam · 금속 은 · 재질 단일(석재) · 체형 매우 큰 가슴·둥근 어깨)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head to just below her chest, the frame cutting off beneath the chest. Her face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Vietnamese woman — soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a short pixie cut. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: An extreme, overwhelming armour of about two hundred real silver piercings with a few red-enamel beads among them covering the face, neck and shoulders: a thick silver septum ring with a smaller ring above it, three silver rings through each nostril and a small stud at the tip of the nose; two straight silver bars across the bridge of the nose between the brows; six silver pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; three rows of five small silver studs across the forehead above the brows; six small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; two rows of six small studs along each cheekbone; a silver Medusa stud above the lips with a small stud on each side of it; a big silver hoop, four smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and six small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a silver labret stud and five rings through the chin; six small studs along each jaw; a column of five small studs down each side of the neck; on each ear a full dense row of twelve oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; a row of six small silver studs along each collarbone, a small silver stud on each shoulder and a column of five small studs down each upper arm; and twelve fine silver chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All jewelry is real silver, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a very large, heavy bust with soft rounded shoulders.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the material reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
